admission_modes.full: verify and optionally stage all 17 streamfold_sumcheck_toy_v2_family payloads by exact path, byte length, SHA-256, JSON object parseability, and symlink-free path ancestry
admission_modes.minimum: verify and optionally stage the four-file first recovery set by the same exact checks

artifact_role: executable isolated candidate payload graft contract for streamfold_sumcheck_toy_v2_family
stage_rules: candidate root must be a real directory and not a symlink
candidate payload paths must be clean POSIX-relative paths below the candidate root
candidate payload leaf and all path ancestors must not be symlinks
candidate payload bytes must match the carried manifest exactly by byte length and SHA-256
JSON and DSSE-named payloads must parse as JSON objects before staging
stage directory must be absent or empty, outside the overlay root, outside the candidate root, and have a real directory parent
staging copies only selected payload files plus deterministic EV_STREAMFOLD_PAYLOAD_GRAFT.rev0860.json and payloads.sha256 files
staging never mutates the overlay bundle and never grants publication rights
